fix: Add the feminine and plural forms 'nulle', 'nuls', 'nulles' to the absence cues (only 'pétales nuls' is listed). Read 'parfois foliacées ou nulles' as an alternative with its own frequency (pattern 08): bract absent, sometimes.

'not very many-flowered' (male inflorescences) fits none of the amounts few, several or many. The only firm content, that the inflorescence has flowers, is trivial. It is too vague to annotate.

fix: Bearer pinna, the division quality (cut PATO:0001978, i.e. incised), and the depth as the distance left between the sinus and the landmark (costa, 1–2 mm) or as a fraction. OWL keeps 'pinna incised'; the depth is a measurement in the record, with the costa as landmark.

fix: The bearer is the corolla throat, not the whole corolla. Allow 'inside'/'outside' as surface context words on a sympetalous corolla tube or throat (now only single perianth members and bracts), as the inner (adaxial) surface or region (slot 1).
